decks.notes: The deck focuses on generating value through blink effects and controlling the game with versatile removal and disruption spells while also having access to a variety of threats. The goal is to outvalue the opponent by using cards like Yorion, Sky Nomad and Ephemerate to repeatedly trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities and keep the opponent on the back foot with counter magic and removal spells. The deck aims to control the board and dictate the pace of the game until it can overwhelm the opponent with its powerful threats and card advantage.

This deck focuses on utilizing cascade cards such as Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to quickly put pressure on the opponent by cheating out powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls. By cascading into low-cost spells like Fire/Ice and Dead/Gone, the deck can control the board while maintaining its aggressive strategy. Additionally, having access to cards like Endurance and Force of Negation allows the deck to interact with the opponent's game plan and protect its own threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient and explosive plays while keeping control of the game.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands to generate large amounts of mana quickly. It utilizes a combination of powerful control tools such as Karn Liberated, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Oblivion Stone to disrupt the opponent's strategy while deploying threats like Walking Ballista, Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, and Wurmcoil Engine to close out the game. The deck also includes utility lands like Sanctum of Ugin and Blast Zone to provide additional advantages in specific situations, making it a versatile and resilient control archetype in the Modern format.

The primary strategy of this deck is to control the game through efficient removal and hand disruption while generating card advantage and mana advantage through cards like Liliana of the Veil and Profane Tutor. With a focus on resource denial and grinding out advantages over time, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in a slow and methodical manner. Additionally, cards like Karn, the Great Creator provide utility and versatility, allowing the deck to adapt to various situations and threats. The mana base is built around maximizing the use of Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to generate large amounts of mana for powerful plays.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful planeswalkers. By playing defensively and controlling the board, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and maintain a strong board presence. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value through blinking creatures and permanents. The deck also includes a variety of versatile cards that can be used in multiple ways, such as Ephemerate and Expressive Iteration. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to maintain control and outvalue the opponent through careful decision-making and resource management.

The deck focuses on using Amulet of Vigor to ramp quickly and efficiently into playing Primeval Titan to search for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Boros Garrison to deal huge amounts of damage to the opponent. With cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Azusa, Lost but Seeking, the deck can generate massive amounts of mana and play multiple lands per turn, enabling explosive plays. The key combo pieces are Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan, allowing the deck to quickly assemble a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent through a mix of direct damage spells and aggressive creatures. By playing cards like Lava Spike, Lightning Bolt, and Boros Charm, the deck aims to apply pressure and force the opponent to react defensively. The creatures, Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, along with Eidolon of the Great Revel, provide additional damage and threaten the opponent's life total. The mana base is designed to support the deck's low curve and ensure consistent access to the spells needed to maintain aggressive momentum.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of card draw, removal spells, and creature generation to set up a powerful combo win condition. By using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Persist, the player can control the board and pressure their opponent with big threats like Archon of Cruelty. The deck also includes tutors like Thoughtseize and Transmogrify to find key pieces of the combo quickly. The diversity of spells and lands in the deck allows for a flexible and adaptable game plan, making it a creative and potentially devastating choice for Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy utilizing artifact creatures and artifacts to quickly build up a strong board presence. The deck aims to quickly deploy threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan with counter spells and removal. The inclusion of cards like Urza, Lord High Artificer and Esper Sentinel provide additional value and card advantage. The goal is to close out the game quickly by leveraging the synergy between artifacts and efficient spells to outpace the opponent.

The deck focuses on ramping up quickly to play powerful threats like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus, while utilizing cards like Explore and Azusa, Lost but Seeking to accelerate mana production. Amulet of Vigor allows for explosive turns by untapping lands, and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove fixes mana and enables powerful land combos. The deck aims to assemble the Amulet Titan combo of Amulet of Vigor, bounce lands, and Primeval Titan to generate an overwhelming board presence and win the game quickly. It also utilizes utility lands such as Bojuka Bog and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to disrupt opponents and close out games.

The deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and the various lands to quickly ramp up mana production and play powerful lands and creatures. The goal is to assemble the right combination of lands to produce a large amount of mana, allowing for explosive plays and ultimately search for and play Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal massive damage to the opponent. By utilizing the unique land interactions and powerful creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful combos and threats.

The focus of this deck is to quickly generate mana and cast multiple spells in a single turn to create a powerful combo. By utilizing various rituals and cantrips, the deck aims to reach a critical mass of mana and spells to either generate a large number of goblin tokens, deal massive damage with Goblin Charbelcher, or overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful spells. The deck does not rely on lands to generate mana, allowing for faster and more explosive plays.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to equip Colossus Hammer for free, giving a creature +10/+10 and trample. The deck includes various ways to search for and protect the combo pieces, as well as disrupt the opponent's plans with counter magic and removal. By setting up this powerful combination, the deck aims to deliver massive amounts of damage in a single swing, overwhelming the opponent and securing victory.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly in order to cast powerful threats like Karn Liberated, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck focuses on controlling the board with removal spells like Oblivion Stone and Relic of Progenitus while using cards like Sylvan Scrying and Expedition Map to search for the Tron lands. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Wurmcoil Engine and Walking Ballista to close out the game.

This deck focuses on quickly casting powerful cards with the Cascade mechanic to overwhelm the opponent and put them on the defensive. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into big threats like Crashing Footfalls, the deck aims to maintain aggressive pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells. The inclusion of versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Prismari Command allows for adaptability in various situations, making it a versatile and unpredictable aggro deck.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game using powerful artifacts and disruption spells, while generating value with Urza, Lord High Artificer and Thopter Foundry + Sword of the Meek combo. The deck aims to slow down opponents with Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismatic Ending, while using cards like Whir of Invention to tutor for key pieces. The deck also includes various utility artifacts like Portable Hole and Aether Spellbomb to deal with threats. Urza's Saga is a key land in the deck, providing additional value and tutoring for important artifacts.
